steps.note: Open the existing prepared live RFQ without creating or searching for another event.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the prepared RFQ.
Assert that Recreate Order is offered and enabled while the RFQ is live.
Open the Recreate Order flow from the event's Settings menu.
Confirm the recreate dialog or screen offers the Create Order action.
Confirm recreation using the default values.
Assert that confirming the recreation does not produce an application error.
Assert that the original prepared RFQ is still marked Live after recreation.
